answer: A sybil farm's puppets share one operator, so every endorsement among them traces back to a single root. Treat trust as a grove: standing accrues only along vouching paths rooted in many separate, long-established trees, and vouchers from one tight cluster count once no matter how many puppets repeat them. Newcomers wander the edge with capped rewards until unrelated groves vouch for them through real, witnessed exchanges. A beacon audit replays each path and prunes branches whose witnesses never actually transacted. One operator cannot fake a forest.
